title: cypripedium calceolus var. planipetalum
intro: Cypripedium calceolus var. planipetalum, commonly known as the yellow lady's slipper, is a rare and unique orchid species native to the northern hemisphere. It is a type of terrestrial orchid characterized by its yellow and green flowers and distinctive slipper-shaped pouch. The health benefits of Cypripedium calceolus var. planipetalum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as calceolic acid, berberine, and palmatine, and flavonoids such as kaempferol and quercetin.
